agent_id.description: the agent's id: its entry `entity:<id>` in the colony's affinity; keep it equal to the door's

identity.description: the agent's AIeOS document, upserted as `entity:<id>` (kind agent); empty = no enrolment

charter.description: the agent's `mx.brain` families (`{identity|persona|handover|instructions: {leaf: text}}`), delivered by a second subscription with `slots: ["brain"]`

disclose.description: field paths (or `{field_path, audience?, audience_set?, mode?}`) released by `set_disclosure`; default the agent itself; `mx.brain` is added with a charter
